name: lazyest-qa
description: Risk-based software QA: test design, execution, automation, regression, and evidence-based release assessment.

interface.shortDescription: Risk-based test design, execution, and QA evidence
interface.longDescription: Apply ISTQB-informed methods to software QA using the existing project tools. Select tests by risk, execute authorized checks, and report defects, evidence, and remaining gaps.
defaultPrompt: Use Lazyest-qa to test this change and report defects and remaining risks.
Use Lazyest-qa to design concrete test cases from these requirements.
Use Lazyest-qa to assess this release using the supplied test evidence.
